quote: All vehicles covered under this Section, as provided in Section 11.38.080, shall carry at least one lighted headlamp capable of showing a white light visible at least three hundred feet in the direction in which the same are proceeding, and one tail lamp mounted on the rear which, when lighted, shall emit a red light plainly visible from at least five hundred feet to the rear. The lights required by this Section shall be burning whenever such vehicles are in motion during the period from one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise and at any other time when, due to insufficient light or unfavorable atmospheric conditions, persons and vehicles on the streets are not clearly discernible at a distance of at least five hundred feet ahead.

activation.description: Covered vehicle in motion within the statutory night or low-visibility period.
activation.source_clause: vehicles covered under this Section, as provided in Section 11.38.080

obligation.description: At least one white forward headlamp and one red rear mounted tail lamp, each with its stated visibility and burning conditions.
obligation.source_clause: white light visible at least three hundred feet

timing.description: Continuous burning while moving in night or reduced 500-foot discernibility.
timing.source_clause: one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: vehicles covered under this Section, as provided in Section 11.38.080
judgment_calls_needed.note: Vehicle coverage under referenced Section 11.38.080 requires legal and original identity review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: white light visible at least three hundred feet

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: red light plainly visible from at least five hundred feet to the rear

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: not clearly discernible at a distance of at least five hundred feet ahead
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original visibility and unfavorable atmosphere need independent 500-foot discernibility review.
